name: Camp Ataya
summary: Camp Ataya is a quiet tauren encampment resting in northern Feralas under the shadow of the Twin Colossals. It provides a rare foothold for the Horde in a wilderness dense with ancient ruins and hostile beasts. Travelers pass through its lean-tos for a moment of quiet rest away from the encroaching wilds.

sections.title: Shelter Beneath the Pillars
sections.body: Tucked away in the northern reaches of Feralas, Camp Ataya serves as an outpost for tauren hunters and wandering travelers under the towering Twin Colossals. It is a humble settlement consisting of simple hide tents, a crackling campfire, and an anvil. While lacking extensive defensive structures, it provides Horde wanderers with a brief respite from the predatory creatures and hostile Woodpaw gnolls prowling the surrounding forests.

faq.answer: Camp Ataya is a small tauren camp located in northern Feralas, nestled right beneath the towering Twin Colossals. It serves as a peaceful rest stop for Horde travelers journeying through the thick wilderness.
The camp is aligned with the Horde, maintained and occupied by tauren scouts and wanderers who watch over the nearby routes in Feralas.
Camp Ataya is quite modest. It hosts a simple campfire for cooking and resting, as well as an anvil for repairs, though it does not possess a full blacksmithing forge.
The wilderness surrounding the Twin Colossals is home to aggressive wildlife, local Woodpaw gnolls, and wandering Gordunni ogres that frequent the forests and ruins across Feralas.

angles.text: Camp Ataya provides familiar shelter under the great trees of Feralas, offering a place of reverence beneath the massive natural stone pillars of the Twin Colossals.
Deep in the primeval canopy of Feralas, this small outpost gives Horde explorers a welcome place to rest and repair equipment in an otherwise untamed territory.
